name: Smoove connector for Elementor forms
author: matansmoove

sections.description:
smoove plugin will send contacts details via POST methode to smoove’s API
smoove is a marketing tool that allows you to create newsletters, SMS, marketing automations, CRM and more
link to the service:
https://rest.smoove.io
link to the service terms of use and privacy policies:
https://www.smoove.io/privacy-policy.aspx
sections.installation:
1. In your Smoove account create an API key.
  2. Please make sure that you have installed Elementor.
  3. Go to plugins in your dashboard and select “Add New”.
  4. Search for the Smoove connector for Elementor forms, install and activate.
  5. Enter the “Smoove settings” in the plugin’s menu and enter the API key and follow the instructions in the description.
sections.faq: For any questions contact our support: https://www.smoove.io/contact-us.aspx
sections.changelog:
4.4.3

  • Fixed: Fields mapping now displays correctly – restored dynamic field generation from version 4.2.0
  • Fixed: JavaScript now properly creates field mapping controls for each form field
  • Fixed: Restored original loading order (lists and fields together)
  • Improved: Better error handling when lists fail to load

4.4.2

  • Performance improvements: Fields load first (fast), then lists (slower)
  • Bug fixes: Fixed syntax errors and improved error handling
  • Better user experience: Fields mapping appears immediately
  • Removed caching to ensure always fresh data from Smoove API

4.4.1

  • Removed caching system for real-time data
  • Improved API request efficiency

4.4.0

  • Added caching system (later removed in 4.4.1)
  • Optimized list fetching loop
